Priscilla Ferreira  
📞 +31 6 1234 5678 | 📧 priscilla.ferreira@sectech.nl | 📍 Amsterdam, Netherlands  

A seasoned mobile security architect with six years of expertise in designing secure, scalable mobile solutions for enterprises. Specialized in building robust security frameworks, optimizing CI/CD pipelines, and leading cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact mobile applications. Proven ability to balance innovation with compliance, ensuring products meet stringent security standards while maintaining user-centric design principles.  

**Professional Experience**  
*Senior Mobile Security Architect*  
SecureTech Innovations | 2021–2023  
- Spearheaded the development of a secure messaging platform for financial institutions, reducing zero-day vulnerabilities by 40% through custom encryption protocols and biometric authentication integration.  
- Redesigned the mobile CI/CD pipeline using GitLab CI/CD, cutting deployment time by 35% and reducing production bugs by 25% through automated security scans.  
- Architected a cross-platform security framework combining Flutter and Kotlin, enabling seamless integration of end-to-end encryption across iOS and Android without compromising performance.  
- Collaborated with legal and compliance teams to align mobile features with GDPR and SOC2 standards, ensuring audit-ready systems for three major clients.  

*Senior Mobile Security Engineer*  
DataGuard Inc. | 2019–2021  
- Led the migration of legacy mobile apps to React Native, improving maintainability while maintaining security compliance for 1.2M active users.  
- Implemented a centralized push notification system using Firebase, reducing latency by 20% and improving user engagement metrics by 15%.  
- Designed REST APIs for a secure document management system, achieving 99.9% uptime and zero critical vulnerabilities in production.  
- Introduced TypeScript across core modules, reducing runtime errors by 30% and accelerating feature development cycles.  

*Mobile Developer*  
CyberShield Solutions | 2017–2019  
- Developed a mobile app for real-time threat detection, integrating GraphQL to fetch security updates from centralized servers.  
- Built a web accessibility-compliant UI using WCAG 2.1 guidelines, improving user satisfaction scores by 22% for disabled users.  
- Optimized mobile app performance by 25% through code refactoring and resource management strategies.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **Kotlin**: Architected secure mobile frameworks, reduced app crashes by 45% through memory management improvements.  
- **Push Notifications**: Engineered scalable notification systems, increasing user retention by 18% for enterprise clients.  
- **REST API Design**: Built secure, high-throughput APIs for financial services, handling 5M+ requests daily with <50ms latency.  
- **React Native**: Refactored legacy codebases, improving maintainability and reducing technical debt by 30%.  
- **Flutter**: Integrated with native modules for secure data handling, achieving 95% compatibility across Android and iOS.  
- **GraphQL**: Streamlined data fetching for real-time security updates, cutting API call overhead by 28%.  
- **JavaScript**: Enhanced client-side security with custom validation logic, blocking 70% of injection attempts.  
- **Mobile CI/CD**: Automated security testing pipelines, reducing manual checks by 60% and improving release consistency.  
- **Web Accessibility (WCAG)**: Redesigned UI components for compliance, ensuring 100% pass rates in automated audits.  
- **TypeScript**: Standardized codebase, reducing runtime errors by 35% and improving team onboarding efficiency.  

**Projects**  
- **Secure Messaging Platform (2022)**: Developed end-to-end encryption framework using Kotlin and REST APIs, achieving 99.99% data integrity.  
- **Cross-Platform Security Framework (2021)**: Built modular architecture with Flutter and Kotlin, enabling rapid deployment of security patches.  
- **GDPR-Compliant Mobile App (2020)**: Designed data handling workflows, reducing compliance risks by 50% for EU clients.  
- **Notification Optimization Project (2019)**: Streamlined Firebase push notifications, improving delivery rates from 82% to 94%.  

**Education**  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | University of California, Berkeley | 2018  

**Certifications**  
- CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)  
- OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)  
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
